dataset_type = 'DOTADataset'
data_root = 'data/ss_dota_split/'
img_norm_cfg = dict(
    mean=[123.675, 116.28, 103.53], std=[58.395, 57.12, 57.375], to_rgb=True)
train_pipeline = [
    dict(type='LoadImageFromFile'),
    dict(type='LoadOBBAnnotations', with_bbox=True,
         with_label=True, obb_as_mask=True),
    dict(type='LoadDOTASpecialInfo'),
    dict(type='Resize', img_scale=(1024, 1024), keep_ratio=True),
    dict(type='OBBRandomFlip', h_flip_ratio=0.5, v_flip_ratio=0.5),
    dict(type='Normalize', **img_norm_cfg),
    dict(type='RandomOBBRotate', rotate_after_flip=True,
         angles=(0, 0), vert_rate=0.5, vert_cls=['roundabout', 'storage-tank']),
    dict(type='Pad', size_divisor=32),
    dict(type='DOTASpecialIgnore', ignore_size=2),
    dict(type='FliterEmpty'),
    dict(type='Mask2OBB', obb_type='obb'),
    dict(type='OBBDefaultFormatBundle'),
    dict(type='OBBCollect', keys=['img', 'gt_bboxes', 'gt_obboxes', 'gt_labels'])
]
test_pipeline = [
    dict(type='LoadImageFromFile'),
    dict(
        type='MultiScaleFlipRotateAug',
        img_scale=[(1024, 1024)],
        h_flip=False,
        v_flip=False,
        rotate=False,
        transforms=[
            dict(type='Resize', keep_ratio=True),
            dict(type='OBBRandomFlip'),
            dict(type='Normalize', **img_norm_cfg),
            dict(type='RandomOBBRotate', rotate_after_flip=True),
            dict(type='Pad', size_divisor=32),
            dict(type='ImageToTensor', keys=['img']),
            dict(type='OBBCollect', keys=['img']),
        ])
]

declared_differences.implementation: Unmodified MMRotate v0.3.4 Oriented R-CNN, not an OBBDetection binary reproduction
declared_differences.batch: Paper 1 GPU x 2; this run 2 GPUs x 1; global batch remains 2
declared_differences.warmup: Use author warmup_ratio=0.001 instead of MMRotate generic 1/3
declared_differences.input: Aspect-preserving 1024 resize, fixed 1024 canvas, native normalized padding value 0
declared_differences.augmentation: MMRotate H/V/diagonal probabilities 0.25 each, equivalent flip outcomes to author independent H/V at 0.5; no project shrink
declared_differences.schedule: Author 12 epochs, LR 0.005, drops at 8/11; no equal-epoch-budget claim
